Rules / Formatting

SK0002 The line is over the width and nothing in it can break

A line exceeds max_line_length and the formatter had no break point to use.

CategoryFormatting
Default severityhint
ScopeSyntax
Needs a compilationno
Runs under --load=looseyes
Cached per fileyes
Fixno
Language version floor—
Since0.2

Why

A 200-character string literal and a deeply-qualified generic type are not the formatter's to shorten: it never breaks a token and never breaks inside a string. Reporting it at hint makes the audit possible without making the ordinary run noisy.

Example

Instead of:

const string Message = "…a literal 200 characters wide…";

Write:

const string Message =
    "…the same literal, on a continuation line…";

When it does not fire

None. The check is a width measurement of the formatter's own output.

Configuration

  • resharper_csharp_max_line_length
